name: @singleton-sd/post-kit-compiler
description: Template compiler for PostKit — validates and compiles EmailBuilder.js source files into deployable HTML artifacts

scripts.lint: echo "lint:compiler — covered by root eslint on staged files"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @singleton-sd/post-kit-types run build && tsc -p tsconfig.spec.json && node --import tsx --test "src/**/*.spec.ts"
